原方程可化为 $y'+\frac{2x}{x^2-1}y=\frac{\cos x}{x^2-1}$，则

$$y=e^{-\int\frac{2x}{x^2-1}\,dx}\left(\int\frac{\cos x}{x^2-1}\cdot e^{\int\frac{2x}{x^2-1}\,dx}\,dx+C\right)$$

$$=\frac{1}{x^2-1}\left[\int\frac{\cos x}{x^2-1}\cdot(x^2-1)\,dx+C\right]=\frac{\sin x+C}{x^2-1}$$
